First time I played there, I had no problems. It was a twosome with my dad and it was a quick round.

Second time was with my friends who were just picking up golf and the marshall gave us a bit of crap for being slow but w/e, we were slow and we tried our best to keep it up. I wasn't happy, but I wasn't going to argue as I thought it was our groups fault. 

Third time I played, I went with my work buddies and it was a group of 8 split into two foursomes. IIRC it was a weekend, so it was a busy day. We were having fun and enjoying our day playing golf, then the marshall came to us around 5th hole and told us that we were extremely behind schedule and that we needed to keep our pace up. Every time since then he kept following us and watched me swing and constantly said we were late. It was extremely irritating that this guy would just keep staring at me play golf and annoy me, it was like he was deliberately trying to throw me off. 

We stopped after 9th to grab a hotdog and we were only about 5 minutes behind schedule (and we couldn't even see the group of 4some behind us, which were our own friends) but he kept going on even after that and told us to pick it up. By 13th or 14th we caught up to the group ahead of us and there was like 3 or 4 groups waiting. We ended up waiting at that hole for about 30 minutes. 

After the round all 8 of us were talking and I told my boss at the time about what happened and he went inside and complained about the issue. Turns out, the guy came to our store before and asked for a discount to which we said no. So idk he was trying to take it out on us or not, but he knew we were from my work as we were getting the industry rate at the time. 

Ever since then, as the nature of my work I'd talk to customers about good courses around a city in the Pacific Northwest and some people were saying things like how the course is in great condition, people who work there are really nice, but some old marshalls are doing a terrible job of taking care of things. 

I never went back to a specific golf course after that and then eventually left the city for school. I still tell people that course is a great course, and I'm sure things have changed since last time I went there, but I don't plan on going back anytime soon.

edit: sorry for the long rant. I just was typing along and didn't realize it got so long.
